==Descriptions==
{{Description|Jinzhou's Panhua restaurant boasts open stoves and a bustling kitchen, making it the city's premier dining destination. With a steady stream of satisfied patrons, this establishment has earned a reputation as the culinary god of Jinzhou, representing its unique Huanglong food culture. Foodies flock here for delectable dishes and to immerse themselves in local gastronomy.}}
